description: Prepare a change to the user's connected account as a DRY RUN: nothing is written. AppGoat reads the live account and returns the before → after diff, guardrail results (AI probabilities for store policy, tone and risky claims, plus checks such as character limits and bid jumps) and an action id. ALWAYS show the diff and any guardrail flags to the user and get their go-ahead before calling apply_action. Types and params (app = a linked App Store id or package name, locale like en-US): review.reply {app, review_id, text} (review ids from read_connection what=reviews; Play replies ≤ 350 chars); listing.update {app, locale, fields: {name|title, subtitle, description, promotional_text, whats_new, marketing_url, support_url, privacy_policy_url}} (Play: title, short_description, full_description, video); keywords.set {app, locale, keywords: [..] or 'a,b,c', mode?: replace|add|remove} (App Store, 100 bytes comma-joined); screenshots.upload {app, locale, display_type: APP_IPHONE_67… (asc) or image_type: phoneScreenshots… (play), images: [{url}], replace?}; ads.keyword.bid {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{id, bid?, status?: ENABLED|PAUSED}], max_increase?}; ads.keyword.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id, keywords: [{text, match_type?: EXACT|BROAD, bid?}]}; ads.negative.add {campaign_id, ad_group_id?, keywords: [{text, match_type?}]} (Apple Ads ids from read_connection what=ads). Cost: 0 credits.

connection.description: Connection id from list_connections; optional when exactly one active connection fits the type and app

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

params.description: Params for the type (see the tool description)

playbook.description: The playbook proposing this, e.g. 'reply-to-every-review' (shown to approvers); omit outside a playbook

type.description: What to change: review.reply, listing.update, keywords.set, screenshots.upload, ads.keyword.bid, ads.keyword.add or ads.negative.add
